decisions.reason: Although the firm has the know-how to maintain this net price display plugin, its basic compliance character and absence from the website make it a likely standalone product to discontinue and absorb into broader client work.
The ERP system interface plugin builds on the firm's core integration capabilities and supports its multichannel strategy, so its strategic fit and learnability argue for retention.
This price comparison tracking plugin still matches the firm's analytics and optimization knowledge well, but overlap with similar offers keeps some consolidation risk in view.

As another largely overlapping price comparison tracking plugin with no recent website visibility, it is the strongest candidate for rationalization so resources can be redirected to stronger core and new development projects.
